nom: Eucerin AtopiControl Crème Corps Calmante Intensive, Peaux Atopiques, 40 ml

avis.titre: Excellent pour traiter le problème des mollets qui grattent
avis.texte: C'est ce que j'ai trouvé de mieux pour traiter mon problème récurrent de crises de démangeaison sur les mollets. J'ai essayé diverses crèmes et huiles dont la Neutrogena pour pieds secs et l'huile de coco. Cela fonctionne un moment et puis le problème redémarre. Le soir après la douche, j'en mets sur mes deux mollets. Ensuite je laisse bien prendre en restant en short pour ne pas enlever de produit tant qu'il n'a pas bien pénétré. Cela fait maintenant un an que le résultat est bon.

avis.titre: Absorbs instantly, calms irritation, and didn't trigger my reactive atopic skin
avis.texte: I have atopic dermatitis and very reactive skin. After showering my skin gets very dry, but during the day it can turn oily. Many creams either irritate me or make me itchy later on. I bought Eucerin AtopiControl Intensive Calming Cream (40ml) for my morning post-shower use and after cleansing my face at night. I've been using it for a few days, and the experience has been really good so far: - Not greasy at all and absorbs instantly (critical for my skin) - Leaves a calm, comfortable feeling right after application (no itching for me) - No bad reaction (rare for my skin) - Reduced redness on my forehead and my skin looks less irritated Overall, it feels effective and gentle. I paid £14.96 for 40ml, which is expensive. But for me it’s worth it. It's one of the very few creams I can finally use without any suffering (no burning, no itch, no flare). If you have atopic dermatitis and struggle to find something that doesn't cause problems, this is worth trying. (I'll update after a few weeks if anything changes.)
